images.c_ravshan: CHAR: Uzbek man Ravshan, 50, neat black mustache with grey strands, short dark hair, brown knitted vest over a light blue shirt, laughing proudly with one hand raised as if telling a story, half body.
images.c_ravshan_hayron: CHAR: Same man as in the reference image (Ravshan, 50, mustache, brown knitted vest, light blue shirt), eyebrows raised in amazement, mouth open, half body.
images.c_ravshan_xafa: CHAR: Same man as in the reference image (Ravshan, 50, mustache, brown knitted vest), wistful nostalgic smile with slightly sad eyes, holding an old audio cassette to his chest, half body.
images.c_temur: CHAR: Uzbek teenage boy Temur, 17, modern haircut, oversized grey hoodie, white wireless earbuds, holding a smartphone, grinning, half body.
images.c_buvi: CHAR: Elderly Uzbek grandmother Oydin, 75, white headscarf tied at the back, colorful atlas-patterned dress, kind wrinkled face, laughing warmly with one hand on her chest, half body.
images.p_kasseta: PROP: an old 1990s audio cassette with a yellow pencil inserted into one spool, tape slightly loose, realistic.
images.01: SCENE: Modern cozy Uzbek living room in the evening, teenage boy Temur (17, grey hoodie, white earbuds) sitting on a sofa enthusiastically showing his smartphone to his father Ravshan (50, mustache, brown knitted vest, light blue shirt) who looks skeptical with a tea cup in hand. Characters on the left and center, calm wall space at top.
images.02: SCENE: 1993, sunny traditional Uzbek courtyard with a grape vine trellis, a young man of 18 with a mustache-free face, 1990s haircut and striped shirt (young Ravshan) sitting on a wooden tapchan carefully rewinding an audio cassette tape with a pencil, an old silver radio cassette player beside him, warm nostalgic light.
images.03: SCENE: Same modern living room, teenage boy Temur (grey hoodie, earbuds) staring in total disbelief, holding his phone, mouth open, sofa and lamp behind him.
images.04: SCENE: 1990s Uzbek bedroom with carpet on the wall, young Ravshan (18, striped shirt) crouched tensely in front of a silver radio cassette player, finger hovering over the record button, waiting for a song on the radio, focused face.
images.04_b: EDIT 04: Only one small change: the young man now grabs his head with both hands in despair, mouth open.
images.05: SCENE: 1990s Uzbek wedding in a courtyard at dusk, a lively woman of 50 in a headscarf and atlas dress (grandmother Oydin when younger) proudly holding up an audio cassette next to a big boombox, guests dancing behind her, string lights.
images.06: SCENE: 1963 European radio exhibition hall, vintage display table with an early portable cassette recorder and small cassettes under spotlight, curious visitors in 1960s suits in the background, no logos.
images.07: SCENE: Dusty home storage room, father Ravshan (mustache, brown vest) and son Temur (grey hoodie) opening an old cardboard box full of hand-labeled audio cassettes, the son amazed, warm light through a small window.
images.08: SCENE: Father Ravshan (mustache, brown vest) and son Temur (grey hoodie) sitting together on the sofa, the son wearing old foam headphones connected to a 1990s portable cassette player, both smiling, the father's arm around his shoulder, warm evening lamp light.

hero: Ravshan aka (50, mo'ylov, jigarrang jilet) + o'g'li Temur (17, quloqchin) + buvi Oydin (Ravshanning onasi)
